deviations.departs: The article deposits no per-device rows and states that no executable implementation accompanies it, so the release executes on a harness device pool rather than on the study's own records.
deviations.reason: Without the study's rows no manuscript table value can be recomputed from this release. Every cohort-level quantity is therefore reported as the release's own on the harness pool, and the manuscript's arithmetic is checked separately from its printed tables.

deviations.paper_location: Sec. Continuous sensing front end, geometric correction [29]
deviations.departs: The functional form of the geometric correction factor is not printed. The release computes it as the tissue-channel floor area over the floor area plus the perimeter term the current path adds through the channel walls.
deviations.reason: The manuscript asserts only that the factor is computed from the printed geometry and never refitted per device, timepoint or arm. The release keeps that property and exposes the expression in one function so the choice is inspectable.

deviations.paper_location: Table S17 footnote; SI per-stage budget
deviations.departs: The backbone's layer structure, optimiser, epoch budget, batch size, warm-up, weight decay, precision and gradient clipping are not printed. The release fixes the latent dimension, learning rate and seed count the manuscript does report and treats the rest as engineering defaults exposed in config.
deviations.reason: Only the deployed learning rate, the five seeds and the latent dimension are recoverable from the record, so everything else is a labelled default rather than an invented manuscript value.

deviations.departs: The mechanistic comparator's equations are not printed. The release implements a first-order threshold recurrence, fitted on held-in series and frozen.
deviations.reason: The manuscript reports the rung's performance without its form, so a labelled recurrence is the only honest way to give the ladder a fourth rung.

deviations.paper_location: Sec. Evaluation metrics and statistical analysis
deviations.departs: The manuscript names mixed models with batch as a crossed factor. The release fits a batch-adjusted fixed-effects linear contrast.
deviations.reason: The run log that would carry the random-effect structure is not deposited. Because the pool is balanced across batches by construction, an additive batch adjustment recovers an injected arm effect with the same estimand.

deviations.departs: Predictive intervals are calibrated on held-out series in the release, because the manuscript states that the backbone supplies no native uncertainty quantification and that its intervals are conformalised after the fact.
deviations.reason: The manuscript states the provenance rather than the estimator, so the release declares the finite-sample upper quantile it uses.

deviations.paper_location: Sec. Forecasting and terminal-assay allocation, Eq. (6)
deviations.departs: The allocation curve's entry is the corrected slope's relative standard error, computed as the ordinary-least-squares standard error over the slope's absolute value divided by the attenuation factor.
deviations.reason: The manuscript's own ablation states that reporting naive slopes gives 14.3% against 18.3% corrected, and 18.3/14.3 equals the reciprocal of the 0.78 factor it corrects at, which fixes the definition rather than leaving it open.

deviations.departs: Allocation candidates are the devices the pool retains, so the release's full budget is its own retained count rather than the printed 148.
deviations.reason: The harness pool's withdrawals fall under the pre-declared rules, so its retained count differs from the design's; using the printed count would be a manuscript value inserted into an executing design.

deviations.departs: The activation entry of the terminal error covariance is a design-time analytical coefficient applied at the spread the pool delivers, taken from the manuscript's own Panel A construction.
deviations.reason: Paired half reads exist for hydroxyproline alone, so only the matrix entry is identified; the manuscript says the other entries are design values at the spread achieved, which is what the release computes rather than assumes.

deviations.departs: Capacity, floating-point counts and fit times are not tuned to the printed parameter counts: the release reports the counts its own backbone carries at each latent dimension.
deviations.reason: Reaching the printed parameter counts would require inventing the layer structure the manuscript does not print; the scaling shape, not the absolute count, is the claim under test.

deviations.paper_location: Sec. Device, cultures and injury model
deviations.departs: The time basis of the pooled regression is a centred power basis with three columns, exposed as a configuration value.
deviations.reason: The manuscript names a smooth basis and states that time enters as a covariate and an interaction without printing its form.

deviations.departs: The four design subsets the collinearity panel prices are not shipped as a cell-level grid, so the release audits the delivered design's own variance inflation factor and condition number instead of reproducing the printed panel.
deviations.reason: Recomputing the printed panel would need the design grid the manuscript does not deposit; the audit quantity itself is implemented and exercised.
